paraphrase: Kāmākhyā is always dharma, Kāmākhyā is wealth, Kāmākhyā the fulfilment of desire, Kāmākhyā liberation; she is the supreme goal, granting the same world and the same form; everything is the own form of the great Goddess Kāmākhyā; without Kāmākhyā nothing exists in the three worlds.
